module: Flowgraph node "Generate Vehicle Group" (category provider, depends on gameplay_traffic_trafficUtils). Generates the data of a vehicle group (output group, vehicleGroupData) for the Spawn Vehicle Group node. Two modes: "Parameters" (standard, simpleTraffic, simpleParked, fromSettings, fromWorld, with cars/trucks/large trucks filters and player/traffic options) and "Custom" (pins model_i / config_i). If the group is empty, falls back to {model='pickup'}.
notes: The "file" mode is no longer handled: use File Vehicle Group (warning in the logs).
onStateStarted sets self.done to false (state hook).

_onDeserialized.desc: Restores the node's own settings from the saved data.

_onSerialize.desc: Adds the node's own settings to the `res` table when saving the graph.

buildGroup.desc: Builds a 'custom' type group from the model_i / config_i pins.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Draws the node's custom properties in the flowgraph editor panel (ImGui).

generateGroup.desc: Builds a 'generator' type group from the chosen parameters (20 vehicles via core_multiSpawn.createGroup or copy from settings/world).

init.desc: Initializes the node's internal state at creation (called by the flowgraph engine).

resetParams.desc: Resets the Parameters mode parameters to their default values.

updatePins.desc: Adds or removes the model_i / config_i pin pairs (Custom mode).

work.desc: Once per run: generates the group (generateGroup or buildGroup) and publishes it on group.
